mapper.sql:
SELECT RTRIM(IC.품목코드) AS IC_CODE , RTRIM(IC.품목명) AS IC_NM , RTRIM(IC.규격) AS IC_STNDRD , IC.업체전용구분 AS IC_ENT_DVR_SE , IC.생산구분 AS IC_PRDCTN_SE , (CASE WHEN ISDATE(OS.수주일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, OS.수주일자) , 126) ELSE OS.수주일자 END) AS OS_RCVORDDE , OS.수주일련번호 AS OS_SN , OS.수주단가 AS OS_UNTPC , (CASE WHEN ISDATE(OS.납기일자) = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CONVERT (DATE, OS.납기일자) , 126) ELSE OS.납기일자 END) AS OS_DEDT , OS.수주수량 AS OS_QUANTITY , OS.수주단위 AS OS_UNIT_CHRCTR
, OS.수주금액 AS OS_SUMAMOUNT , OS.착지업체 AS OS_ALOCENTRPS , RTRIM(OS.비고) AS OS_NOTE , OS.수주수량KG AS OS_WT
, (SELECT RTRIM(CM2.상호) FROM 거래처MASTER CM2 WHERE CM2.거래처코드 = (CASE WHEN LEN(OS.착지업체) < 1 THEN OS.거래처코드 ELSE OS.착지업체 END) AND CM2.등록사업장 = OS.수주사업장) AS DLVYENTRPSNM
, COUNT(OS.납기일자) OVER (PARTITION BY OS.착지업체, OS.납기일자) AS CO , SUM(OS.수주수량KG) OVER (PARTITION BY OS.착지업체, OS.납기일자) AS QYSM
, SUM(OS.수주금액) OVER (PARTITION BY OS.착지업체, OS.납기일자) AS AM , CONVERT(VARCHAR(8),DATEADD(DD, 5, #{listStartDt}),112) AS listStartDt
FROM 수주명세서 OS JOIN 품목코드 IC WITH(NOLOCK) ON (OS.수주품목코드 = IC.품목코드 AND OS.수주사업장 = IC.사업장)
JOIN 웹출고상세_VIEW WDD ON(OS.수주사업장 = WDD.수주사업장 AND OS.수주일자 = WDD.수주일자 AND OS.수주일련번호 = WDD.수주일련번호)
